findings.claim: The TASK-0001 reading list names only the `*.commands.openapi.json` contracts, but the task asks for GET operations by `operationId` (line 26) and says any missing source becomes `source_pending`. Most GETs are in the query specs, which are not listed: `BP-INF-AIT-001.commands` has 1 GET and 17 mutations, while `BP-OPS-FIELD-001.openapi.json` has 26 GETs. `BP-OPS-AGENCY-001.commands.openapi.json` does not exist, but `BP-OPS-AGENCY-001.openapi.json` does. As written, the worker would mark read operations that do exist as `source_pending`, and routes that should be `somente-leitura` would be wrongly classified as `fail-closed-OD`. TASK-0002 would then carry the same gaps into its ODs and screen specs (fichas).
findings.fix: Add the query specs `docs/framework/contracts/BP-INF-AIT-001.openapi.json` and `BP-OPS-{FIELD,OFFLINE-SYNC,EVIDENCE,SNAPSHOTS,PROVISIONING,AGENCY,PARAMETER}-001.openapi.json` to the closed reading list. Use `source_pending` only when neither the query spec nor the commands spec exists. Recompute the sha256/pc_id in `compositions.json` and `tasks/TASK-0001.json`.

findings.claim: The model ladder (`docs/meta/agents/orchestra/model-ladder.md`, 'Escolha por tipo de tarefa' table) puts `architect-blueprint` at the medium tier, which is Terra `gpt-5.6-terra` with high effort.
